description: This file implements classes and methods for handling F1 interface bearer procedures in a 5G NR DU context, including processing SDUs, managing PDCP SN notifications, and generating F1AP messages for UE bearers.

classes.name: f1c_srb0_du_bearer
classes.description: Handles F1 interface procedures for SRB0, including SDU handling and message transfer.

classes.name: f1c_other_srb_du_bearer
classes.description: Manages F1 interface procedures for other SRBs, including SDU processing, PDCP SN notifications, and delivery reports.

methods.name: handle_sdu
methods.description: Processes incoming SDUs, constructs F1AP messages, and notifies upper layers.

methods.name: handle_transmit_notification
methods.description: Handles transmission notifications; not applicable for SRB0.

methods.name: handle_delivery_notification
methods.description: Handles delivery notifications; not applicable for SRB0.

methods.name: handle_pdu
methods.description: Forwards PDU to lower layers after switching to UE execution context.

methods.name: handle_pdu_and_await_delivery
methods.description: Handles PDU and waits for delivery confirmation or timeout.

methods.name: handle_pdu_and_await_transmission
methods.description: Handles PDU and waits for transmission confirmation.

methods.name: handle_notification
methods.description: Updates PDCP SN status and triggers waiting coroutines upon notification.

methods.name: wait_for_notification
methods.description: Returns an awaitable that completes when the specified PDCP SN is delivered or transmitted.

methods.name: handle_rrc_delivery_report
methods.description: Constructs and sends an RRC delivery report message to the gNB-CU.
